newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady, with a few price gains attributed to tight nearby supplies, millfeed dealers said.
Flour mills were either taking down time for maintenance or running reduced production schedules, dealers said.

Buffalo sources said Canadian demand for locally produced millfeeds kept prices firm there. However, the availability of lower-priced product in Pennsylvania prevented Buffalo suppliers from raising offers.
Midwest and Texas markets were quiet as farmers focused on planting corn.
Carolina offers were steady but dealers said the market had a weak undertone because of seasonal declines in feed usage.
